Now I see the issue! Look at line 2387:

```cpp
case Tlv::kResponse:
    SuccessOrExit(error = AppendResponse(*message, aChallenge.GetChallenge(), aChallenge.GetLength()));
    break;
```

`aChallenge.GetLength()` returns the TLV length field. But `aChallenge.GetChallenge()` returns a pointer to `mChallenge[8]`. If the TLV length is > 8, then `AppendResponse` will call `aMessage.Append(aResponse, aResponseLength)` where `aResponseLength > 8`, causing `Write` to READ beyond the `mChallenge[8]` buffer!

But wait, `ChallengeTlv::IsValid()` checks `GetLength() >= kMinSize` where `kMinSize = 4`. So a length of 255 would pass `IsValid()`.
